chapter: Joseph Thomas band and house parties
title: House parties and fish fries
summary: Allen asks about the early parties; Williams describes twenty-five-cent house parties with piano and drums in the back rooms, and fish fries.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Let's see, well this is already the third reel of Abby Williams. Not really. Not really. The first one didn't work. Hold on, there's so many people I want to ask you about and we're getting it all mixed up. After you finished playing these little parties, what kind of parties were they that you played with the piano players?
Well that was like, it was twenty-five cents to come in. Was it a fish fry or just for food?
No, they had fish fry. We played the fish fry. But these was real house parties. You know? Long parties inside?
In the house. No long parties. Piano, second room and third room. All the front is out. And that's where the thing went on at. I used to give them too.
Did they do that to make the rent ever? Eh? Did they ever do that so they could make the rent in different places?
